title: Kingdom life fling all
script:
function Destroy(instance)
    spawn(function()
        for _, folder in ipairs(game.ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:GetChildren()) do
            if folder:IsA("Folder") then
                for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                    if obj:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                        pcall(function()
                            obj:FireServer(instance)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Call Destroy for every Instance in workspace
for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if v:IsA("Instance") then
        Destroy(v)
    end
end
